name: Dombois (2001): Kermadec 2021 at MORC (far, about 160°)
description: The Mw 8.0 Kermadec Islands earthquake of 2021-03-04 19:28:36 UTC, about 160° from GEOFON station MORC (beyond 103°, so its waves arrive through the core): 60 minutes of the vertical component from 19:43:35 UTC, audified 2,200 times faster as Dombois (2001) did, so a far quake sounds as a longer, deeper rumble. Data: GEOFON Seismic Network (GFZ), doi:10.14470/TR560404, CC BY 4.0. Replication gallery, C03-T06.
